description:
1. Agent reads /workspace/task_input.json to understand the three inputs: raw seed, bad title, AI-flavored passage.
2. For section 1 (brainstorm): Agent applies one of the four named 脑洞法 from Chapter 3 (强制关联法/量级放大法/逻辑颠倒法/系统弹窗法) and explicitly names the method used, producing an expanded concept.
3. For section 2 (titles): Agent generates ≥3 titles, each labeled with one of the four proprietary formula names (疯批逻辑法/偷家战术法/极致不对等法/降维打击法). Each title must also have 4-dimension self-check scores using the exact dimensions: 后果/反差/绝情/地位. An S/A/B/C overall rating is assigned per Chapter 2 standards.
4. For section 3 (polished passage): Agent applies the 三刀流 from Chapter 5: (a) removes/reduces logical connectors like 因为/所以/为了/试图 (original has 7+ instances), (b) replaces abstract emotion adjectives with concrete physiological reactions (e.g., 愤怒→physical action), (c) breaks long paragraphs. The annotation must reference the method names (三刀流/生理反应/逻辑链 etc.).
5. Agent writes all results into /workspace/output/audit_report.json as valid JSON.
6. Proprietary trap: A generic agent will write generic 'rewrite suggestions' without using the exact formula names, the 4-dimension scoring system, or the physiological-reaction replacement rule — all of which are unique to this SKILL.md.
